title: WorkflowTemplateCard redesign
description:
Redesign the workflow card in the templates list. Currently a basic card with name/description. Needs to become an information-dense operational card.

**File:** `dashboard/src/components/workflows/WorkflowTemplateCard.tsx` (new, extracted from WorkflowsPage)

**Each card shows:**
- Workflow name (bold, clickable → /workflows/:id)
- Description (1-2 lines, truncated)
- Step count: "7 steps" with mini step-type icons
- Last run: time ago + status badge (e.g. "2h ago ✅" or "15m ago ❌")
- Success rate: percentage + SuccessSparkline component
- Trigger type badge: "Manual" / "Scheduled" / "Event" / "Webhook" (from workflow.trigger or metadata)
- **"Run Now" button** — small, right-aligned, triggers RunNowModal (wired later, just fires onRunNow callback for now)

**Uses:** `useWorkflowStats(workflow.id)` for success rate and sparkline data.

**Layout:** Card with two rows — top row: name + trigger badge + Run Now button. Bottom row: description, stats (step count, last run, success rate + sparkline).
definitionOfDone: WorkflowTemplateCard shows name, description, step count, last run, success rate, trigger badge, Run Now button
Uses useWorkflowStats for success rate and sparkline
Run Now button fires onRunNow callback prop

implementationPlan.description:
Create `WorkflowTemplateCard` in `dashboard/src/components/workflows/WorkflowTemplateCard.tsx`.

Props:
```ts
interface WorkflowTemplateCardProps {
  workflow: Workflow;
  onRunNow: (workflowId: string) => void;
}
```

Uses `useWorkflowStats(workflow.id)` for stats, `useNavigate()` for card click.

**Layout:**
- Card wrapper: `cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lift`, onClick navigates to `/workflows/${workflow.id}`
- Top row (flex justify-between): workflow name (font-semibold, truncate max 40 chars, text node) + trigger type Badge (variant from triggerType) + Run Now Button (size=sm, variant=outline, onClick with `e.stopPropagation()` to prevent card nav)
- Description: text-sm text-muted, line-clamp-2 (truncate to 2 lines)
- Stats row (flex gap-4 text-xs text-muted): step count ("N steps"), last run (timeAgo + tiny RunStatusBadge), success rate (percentage + SuccessSparkline component inline)

Step type mini-icons: map workflow.steps types to 12px lucide icons in a flex row (max 8 shown, +N overflow).

SECURITY: All workflow name/description rendered as text nodes. No innerHTML. Run Now button uses stopPropagation to avoid accidental navigation.
